establishedFacts: Third-run typed value equality succeeded, but final sentence was absent from the original final video frame; measured caret end451.667 exceeded visible end273 (+1 test tolerance gives274).

NowNoteView sets focused editor height from GeometryReader.size.height minus48; its footer is a safeAreaInset. Outer reveal only reacts to focus, viewport.size and Dynamic Type, while UITextView independently owns text scrolling.

ParityScrollMetrics reads public UITextView bounds, adjustedContentInset and insertion caret in window coordinates on a150ms timer. It does not mutate scrolling. The test clips this raw frame to root and outer visible regions.
diagnosticProposals.hypothesis: The expanded Done/Save footer reduces the actual visible region while an editor-size or nested-scroll reveal assumption leaves the insertion point below it. This is consistent with the artifacts but not a proven single UIKit/SwiftUI root cause. A transient stale metric is insufficient to explain the absent last sentence in the final rendered video.
minimalRepairDirection: First restrict production changes to NowNoteView: express content region and existing two-row footer as explicit vertical siblings so the GeometryReader receives the remaining keyboard-safe height, rather than assuming safeAreaInset changes its size proposal. Keep footer controls fully Dynamic Type-aware, retain44pt minimum hit target, and preserve V4 separation.

Derive TextEditor capacity from that actual content region with its existing panel padding. Preserve focus on text changes. Reveal the outer editor only when focus or available region changes; do not scroll the outer page on every keystroke. Avoid fixed keyboard heights or subtracting the observed177pt delta.

If the corrected real UITextView bounds are fully visible but selection still escapes during input, add a narrowly scoped production editor caret-reveal mechanism after actual text/selection/layout updates. Only scroll when first responder, insertion selection is empty, composition is not active, and caret is outside the effective visible area. Scroll the caret rectangle into view without replacing text or moving selection. Keep this out of the read-only DEBUG probe.

Before a future assertion abort, attach the original screenshot and raw inner/outer/root geometry plus caret/selection state so the failure is diagnosable. Do not alter or enlarge the accepted visible frame. Preserve current strict tail visibility, full typed-value equality, Done dismissal, save/relaunch persistence and coverage requirements.
risks: Changing parent layout can alter non-editing spacing and outer scroll position; compare empty/written/default/large notes with keyboard shown and hidden.
Forcing a jump to text.endIndex on every edit breaks middle-of-document editing, selection and Chinese marked text. Conditional caret reveal must preserve insertion position and composition.
Duplicate safe-area or footer subtraction can reduce editor height twice; measure the actual region once. Small screens and large text must still leave a usable editor.

SwiftUI TextEditor introspection is fragile. If explicit UITextView ownership becomes necessary, scope it to this editor and preserve bindings, accessibility identifier, Dynamic Type, keyboard behavior and input method state.
Changing DEBUG geometry to drive the production scroll would both mask the product defect and invalidate evidence; probes remain read-only.
